function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values (848 rows, 800 unique IDs), which means some patients appear more than once — specifically, 48 patients were re-tested and appear twice.", "implication": "The current data has multiple rows per patient. Since we are computing a patient-level outcome ('responded'), we must deduplicate on `patient_id` to avoid double-counting. The data dictionary states that the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for the same patient. Therefore, we must keep only the row with the maximum `sample_seq` per `patient_id` before computing the fraction."}
function.name: note_finding
